summary.what_it_is: OpenMausBot is a cross-platform desktop chat app where each contact is an AI agent (Claude, Codex, or Grok CLI) running locally on your machine. Agents have their own personalities, models, and can use a cloud desktop, local VM, or your computer to perform tasks.
summary.why_trending: No clear reason in the project's own text.
summary.who_its_for: Developers and power users who want a local-first, self-hosted multi-agent chat interface using their existing CLI subscriptions.
